_doc: SrVO3 ground state + chi0 against the A6 hp.x oracle (IntegrationTests/QE/srvo3.*: U(V 3d) 6.2502 eV, chi0(V,V) -1.7822, chi -0.1436 1/eV at
U_in ~ 0, q 2x2x2, k 4x4x4).  A METAL: Fermi smearing kT 0.01 Ha.  ⚠ the oracle used GAUSSIAN smearing degauss 0.02 Ry; ours is Fermi-Dirac only, so
the matched oracle is hp.x re-run with smearing='fd' (degauss 0.02 Ry = kT 0.01 Ha).  Seed = neutral SAD (IonicSAD would want a Sr2+ q2 entry
with ZERO valence electrons, which valgen cannot mint).  Recipe otherwise NiO's: VA spherical + vet 1e-3, Kerker/Pulay 8/5, MaxDeltaD 1e-6.

2026-10-05: globalFermi TRUE -- the first run (r002, default per-k Fermi levels) gave chi0(q != 0) POSITIVE, sign-flipped against hp.x: a metal needs ONE Fermi level across the k-mesh.  The deck pre-flight and Reference::Gap now refuse that combination.
Matched oracle (hp.x re-run with smearing='fd', degauss 0.02 Ry, ~/Code/qe-runs/SrVO3/srvo3fd.*): U(V 3d) = 6.1772 eV; chi0 per q-star Γ -0.474, (0,0,½) -1.583, (0,½,½) -1.565, (½,½,½) -1.492 1/eV.

2026-10-05 (r004+): the ORTHO-ATOMIC SET -- QE's ortho-atomic orthogonalises against EVERY atom's pseudo-atomic orbitals, so the deck lists them as U = 0 spectators (V 4s, Sr 5s, O 2s/2p), NiO's orthofull pattern.  With V 3d alone (r003) the V 3d occupation was 2.53 against QE's 3.50 and chi0(R=0) -1.188 against -1.426.
